description: Clean annotation policy for ATC instruction intent parsing. V1.3 separates intent-type annotation from full frame annotation.

notes: Extra predicted intent types count as false positives.
Missing gold intent types count as false negatives.
Use this level for current intent-understanding progress reporting.

L2_action.purpose: Action-level annotation inside each intent type.

L3_frame.purpose: Structured digital instruction extraction and downstream execution.
L3_frame.slot_policy: Fill slots when explicitly present or directly inferable. Do not fabricate missing slots.

status_values.done: The utterance contains at least one actionable or classifiable ATC/control intent.
status_values.skip: No actionable/classifiable ATC intent, or the text is too incomplete to judge.
status_values.pending: Unreviewed sample. Must not be used in final metric denominators.

altitude_change.l1_definition: Instruction to climb or descend to an altitude.
altitude_change.boundary: If climb/descend wording is present, do not add altitude_maintain just because the phrase contains maintain/keep.

altitude_maintain.l1_definition: Instruction to maintain a specific altitude without climb/descend wording.

speed_adjust.l1_definition: Instruction to set, reduce, increase, or maintain a specific speed.

speed_procedure.l1_definition: Instruction to follow normal/procedural speed without a numeric target.

heading_change.l1_definition: Instruction to fly/maintain/intercept a heading or turn by an explicit heading/angle.
heading_change.boundary: Do not mark bare left/right turn for runway exit or taxi unless an explicit heading, angle, or localizer is given.

direct_to_fix.l1_definition: Instruction to fly direct to a named fix, waypoint, or navaid.
direct_to_fix.boundary: Direct-to-fix has priority over heading_change unless a separate heading is explicitly given.

approach_clearance.l1_definition: Actual clearance/instruction to perform or continue approach.
approach_clearance.boundary: Forecasts, questions, and another aircraft's approach are not approach_clearance.

procedure_assignment.l1_definition: Instruction to follow or join a named procedure, route, SID, STAR, arrival, or departure procedure.

restriction_cancel.l1_definition: Instruction to cancel a restriction, offset, or resume own navigation when it cancels a prior constraint.

frequency_transfer.l1_definition: Instruction to contact/switch/transfer to another unit or frequency.

report_requirement.l1_definition: Explicit requirement for the pilot to report a state, position, readiness, or condition.
report_requirement.boundary: A statement that someone has reported something is not a report requirement.

radar_service.l1_definition: Radar identification, radar service termination, or radar vectoring.

holding_instruction.boundary: A plain 'wait a moment' coordination phrase defaults to other_control.

weather_deviation.l1_definition: Weather deviation, weather avoidance, or weather-related offset.

go_around_or_diversion.l1_definition: Go-around, diversion, or missed approach instruction.

takeoff_or_departure_instruction.l1_definition: Takeoff clearance, runway hold for takeoff, or departure climb instruction.

traffic_information.l1_definition: Traffic advisory, conflict/situational traffic information, or similar callsign warning.

confirmation_request.l1_definition: Controller asks for confirmation, information, or feasibility.

other_control.l1_definition: Operational/control-related utterance not covered by the specific classes.

other_control_subtypes.ground_movement: Taxi, vacate, exit runway/taxiway, continue taxi, enter stand/position.
other_control_subtypes.apron_pushback_tow: Apron, pushback, startup, tow tractor, parking bay/stand.
other_control_subtypes.runway_crossing_or_hold_short: Runway crossing or hold-short instructions that are not takeoff clearance.
other_control_subtypes.operational_ack_or_approval: Okay, approved, received, go ahead, or generic controller acknowledgement without a more specific clearance.
other_control_subtypes.flow_or_restriction_coordination: Flow, restriction, spacing, influence, cannot cross/cut, or operational coordination.
other_control_subtypes.expected_information: Expected runway, expected wait/weather/flow information without explicit clearance or report requirement.
other_control_subtypes.unclear_control: Control-related but not stable enough to assign a subtype; must be reviewed.

conflict_resolution_rules: Numeric altitude/speed/heading/frequency/QNH controls take priority over other_control.
Actual approach/landing/takeoff clearance takes priority over other_control.
direct_to_fix takes priority over heading_change when a named fix is the target.
Questions or feasibility checks take confirmation_request before clearance classes.
Runway or taxiway exit is other_control, not weather_deviation.
Climb/descend plus maintain is altitude_change only, not an extra altitude_maintain.
Plain wait-a-moment coordination is other_control; explicit hold/orbit/expect-hold is holding_instruction.
If the annotator/model cannot make a stable decision, set review_required=true.
review_required_when: utterance has three or more intents
utterance contains ambiguous words such as maintain, continue, possible/can, wait, exit/vacate, expected
intent type is low frequency in the current reviewed set
GPT preannotation disagrees with rule or Qwen comparison prediction
recommended_workflow: Generate rule or Qwen comparison predictions.
Mark agreement samples as high confidence.
Send disagreements, skip rows, other_control rows, and low-frequency intents to review.
Freeze a 300-500 utterance reviewed gold set before reporting final metrics.
Use unrevised GPT labels only as weak labels or fine-tuning candidates, not final gold.
